templates.title: Orpheum
templates.description: A self-hosted video media server: your films and series in any browser and on TVs, at home and away
templates.note: Set the data folder and the media folder. Once it is up, open http://<this machine's address>:8440 from home and enter the one-time setup code: it is in SETUP-CODE.txt in the data folder's orpheum folder, and in the orpheum-core container's log. The install guide says more.

env.name: PATH_TO_APPDATA
env.label: Data folder
env.description: The folder that holds each app's data; Orpheum keeps its own in orpheum/ there

env.name: ORPHEUM_MEDIA
env.label: Media folder
env.description: The folder that holds your films and series, as this machine names it

env.name: ORPHEUM_LAN_ADDRESS
env.label: Address at home
env.description: Optional: this machine's address on your home network, 192.168.1.20; learned from the first browser at home when not set

env.name: ORPHEUM_MEDIA_2
env.label: Second media folder
env.description: Optional: another folder of films or series

env.name: ORPHEUM_MEDIA_3
env.label: Third media folder
env.description: Optional: another folder of films or series

env.name: ORPHEUM_MEDIA_4
env.label: Fourth media folder
env.description: Optional: another folder of films or series

env.name: APPUSER_PUID
env.label: User ID
env.description: Who the server runs as and owns its data

env.name: APPUSER_PGID
env.label: Group ID
env.description: The group the server runs as and owns its data

env.name: ORPHEUM_HTTP_PORT
env.label: HTTP port
env.description: The port a browser at home opens it on

env.name: ORPHEUM_HTTPS_PORT
env.label: HTTPS and WebRTC port
env.description: The port devices at home reach it on over HTTPS, and over WebRTC (UDP)

env.name: ORPHEUM_THIS_MACHINE_PORT
env.label: This machine's port
env.description: The port a browser on this machine alone opens it on, as at home: the way in when admin is refused elsewhere

env.name: ORPHEUM_ROUTER
env.label: Router
env.description: Optional: your router's address, 192.168.1.1, which the server asks to forward the HTTPS port

env.name: ORPHEUM_NAME
env.label: Node name
env.description: The name the media node goes by in the server's pages
